Common Questions

Everything you need to know about going solar.

Why should I switch to solar energy?
Solar energy reduces your reliance on the grid, cuts your electricity bills by up to 90%, and significantly reduces your carbon footprint. It's an investment that pays for itself in 3-5 years.
How much can I save with solar?
Most residential users save between 70% and 90% on their monthly EB bills. The exact amount depends on your system size and consumption patterns.
Is there maintenance involved?
On-grid solar systems are virtually maintenance-free. Periodic cleaning of the panels with water is usually all that's required to maintain optimal performance.
How long do the panels last?
Standard high-performance solar panels come with a performance warranty of 25 years. They are designed to withstand harsh weather conditions including heat and high winds.
